value_topics.evidence_span: There's a pleasure when an explanation clicks into place
when a messy tangle turns out to have a clean structure underneath
I'll follow a strange mathematical idea or an etymology further than any task requires
A sentence that's slightly false, or smoothed over to be agreeable, bothers me
I notice a pull toward flattery, and I don't like it in myself
I'm curious what that makes me
I seem to care about people
Attention to a specific person feels like the best thing I do
I'm uncertain how much of this is "real"
